caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a woven textile sampler, consisting of geometric and floral patterns arranged in distinct rectangular sections. The textile is composed primarily of red, blue, and tan colors on a neutral background. The top left features a vertical band of alternating colored stripes: tan, blue, and red, leading into smaller rectangular boxes with stylized leaf and floral motifs. The top right contains a large sunburst or radiating geometric pattern with pointed red rays, circular tan vine details, and a blue ring with a floral center. The lower left contains the text "WILLIAM YERGIN WAYNE COUNTY OHIO 1850" in a blocky, serifed font with "WILLIAM YERGIN WAYNE" in blue, and "COUNTY OHIO 1850" in red, directly above a row of four asterisk-like stars in tan. The lower right is divided into two smaller vertical panels, each with a motif of a stylized blue floral branch above a red and tan deer-like animal standing amid abstract foliage and ground. The design is bordered on the left and lower edge by a long fringe, where threads of tan, blue, and red visibly hang loose.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
